[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (string: String) (substring: String) : Nat :=
let rec count_occurrences (string: String) (substring: String) (index: Nat) (count: Nat) : Nat :=
  match string with
  | string.head :: string.tail =>
    if index + substring.length ≤ string.length then
      if string.drop index.take substring.length = substring then
        count_occurrences string.substring (substring: String) (index + 1) (count + 1)
      else
        count_occurrences string.substring (substring: String) (index + 1) count
    else
      count
  | [] => count
count_occurrences string.substring substring 0 0
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation string substring
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
by_cases h_substring_empty: substring.length = 0
-- case where substring is empty
simp [h_substring_empty]
by_cases h_string_empty: string.length = 0
-- case where string is empty
simp [h_string_empty]
linarith
-- case where string is empty and substring is not
simp [h_string_empty]
by_cases h_substring_non_empty: substring.length ≠ 0
-- case where substring is non-empty
simp [h_substring_non_empty]
have h_string_less_than_substring: string.length < substring.length := by
  linarith
simp [h_string_less_than_substring]
linarith
-- case where string and substring are the same length
have h_string_substring_same_length: string.length = substring.length := by
  linarith
simp [h_string_substring_same_length]
have h_string_eq_substring: string = substring := by
  linarith
have h_string_neq_substring: string ≠ substring := by

simp [h_string_neq_substring]
